_meta.purpose: AXE-EXP-1 (a11y axe audit, e2e/a11y-axe-authenticated.spec.ts) — accepted pre-existing violation rule IDs per authorized QA-harness route:theme key. The gate fails on NEW rules and on stale entries (findings that no longer reproduce must be removed from this file — the baseline must shrink, not rot).
_meta.policy: Adding a rule here requires a documented justification. FORBIDDEN: adding a rule to make a failing audit pass without justification (Rule 13 analog). Every entry is a PRE-EXISTING finding first baselined at AXE-EXP-1 (probe on main aca7d96a8, 02.09.2026, 34 audits, 236 nodes); the shrink-only ratchet stays in force across the AXE-EXP track.
_meta.scope: Authorized QA-harness surfaces only (e2e/support/authenticatedQa.ts): 6 role homes (admin/registrar/doctor/cashier/lab/patient) + 2 specialty surfaces (doctor-cardiology, doctor-dermatology ?tab=appointments) + 9 admin-family routes × light/dark = 34 audits. _meta.resolution: AXE-EXP-2 (app-chrome inks, plan §4.1.24 follow-up track): the universal chrome class is fixed — header search ⌘K hint chip (tertiary ink on tertiary bg, 3.9:1 light / 1.89:1 dark), the ⌘K command-palette trigger (undefined --mac-surface-secondary token resolved to the light literal #f3f4f6 in dark: 2.6:1), and the inactive sidebar count badge (3.95:1 dark) — all migrated to the new canonical --mac-text-on-tertiary token (light #455568 = 5.71:1 on #d7e1ee; dark #c7c7cc = 6.74:1 on #3a3a3c; tokens.css). 10 keys dropped color-contrast entirely (registrar/doctor ×2 themes, admin-services:light, admin-appointments ×2, admin-system ×2, admin-clinic-settings:light); 4 more keys went fully CLEAN and left the baseline. Remaining color-contrast keys (13) are the AXE-EXP-3 (badge fills) / AXE-EXP-4 (tab inks, link inks, tertiary admin texts) classes; ARIA rules are AXE-EXP-5.
